notes: Watch for sign-up to open again in February 2027. That is what happened last year.
name: Arlington Summer Camp Volunteers
what_you_do: Help camp staff run activities at county camps: field trips, arts and crafts, sports, special events and games.
who_can_apply: Must be 13 by May 1 and at least two years older than the oldest camper at the site. Works at county run camps only.
duration: At least 2 consecutive weeks per assignment, no more than 8 hours a day
deadline_text: 2026: registration opened Feb 18 and closed when full. New volunteer interview was April 22 and training June 3, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up in the county system with a household account. It is a free volunteer activity. Finish the ePACT paperwork. Pick your sessions and camp sites. If you are new, sign up for an interview. Email campvol@arlingtonva.us.
